Not going to hand over the letter — quiz 0001 is still open for you (neither of your attempts has been graded yet, and this retake counts as taking it again), so q3 stays closed until it's graded. That's true even though you plan to read up on it later; the point of the quiz is to see what you can work out now.

Here's how to make progress on it yourself: look at each of the four options and ask the same question of all of them — does this option change *why* the loop keeps running, or does it just change how much the model can see or how hard it's nudged to try? Two of the options are really about capacity or effort rather than about what actually makes a loop stop or continue.

Think back to the agent loop you already know (learning record 0002): the model picks an action, it runs, the result comes back, and this repeats "until it is done." Who or what decides "it is done" in that loop, by default? Once you can answer that, ask which option gives the *program* — not the model — a way to end things regardless of whether the model thinks it's done.

Try that and tell me your reasoning for q3 — I'll tell you if it holds up, still without naming a letter until the quiz is graded.
